TODAY IN POKÉMON GO

Thursday, November 12, 2026

What’s going on in Pokémon today?

How to play every day

The daily basics, in plain words. Do these every day and you stay ahead without grinding.

🎣 First catch + first spin

Catch one Pokémon and spin one PokéStop (or Gym) every day. You get bonus XP, Stardust, and items. Do it 7 days in a row and day 7 pays out big — extra XP and Stardust, a pile of items, and an evolution item from the spin streak. Resets at midnight.

🎟️ Free Raid Pass

Spin the Photo Disc at any Gym once a day and you get a free orange Raid Pass. You can only hold one at a time, so use it before you spin for another one. It only works for in-person raids — save it for a raid you actually want.

🎁 Send + open gifts

Spin PokéStops and Gyms to collect gifts, then send them to friends. Open up to 30 gifts a day from friends. Gifts hold Poké Balls, potions, berries, Stardust, and sometimes a 7 km egg. Sending and opening gifts builds friendship — better friends mean cheaper trades, extra balls in raids, and big XP.

🐾 Feed your buddy

Give your buddy berries so it walks with you. Walking with your buddy earns candy for that Pokémon — that is how Teddiursa candy adds up for Ursaluna.

✨ Max Particles

Power Spots are the purple glowing spots on the map. Tap one to collect 100 particles (120 the first time you visit a new one). Walk 2 km and claim 300 more from the Power Spot tab in the Nearby screen. Up to 800 a day, hold up to 1,500. Full how-to is in Poké Prep below.

🌿 Daily Incense

You get a free 15-minute Adventure Incense every day. Turn it on when you are walking and Pokémon will come to you.

🍍 Pinap berries

Feed a Pinap berry to a Pokémon before you catch it and you get double candy. Save Pinaps for Community Days and Spotlight Hours, when candy matters most.

🍇 Team gym berries

Feed berries to your own team’s Pokémon in a Gym to earn Stardust (and sometimes a candy).

🔵 Plus+

If you have a Pokémon GO Plus+, let it catch and spin for you while you are out — it plays passively so you do not have to stare at your phone.

🕐 Around your day

Morning: first catch + first spin. Out and about: spin a Gym for the free Raid Pass, tap any purple Power Spots you pass. Evening: send and open gifts. Bedtime: clean out your bag so there is room for tomorrow.

🎈 TMs — change a Pokémon’s moves

A Fast TM changes the fast move (the quick tap attack). A Charged TM changes the charged move (the big attack). Use one when a Pokémon has the wrong move for the battle — each raid counter shows its best moves right under its name in the Raids section above, labeled Fast and Charged so you know which TM to use. You get TMs from raids, research, and the shop. Don’t spend them on Pokémon you won’t battle with. Some moves can’t be learned with a regular TM at all (they need an Elite TM) — if a counter’s best move won’t appear, use the next-best move of the same type.

Go Battle League · Nov 10–17

Great League, Ultra League: Mega Edition, and the 2026 GO LAIC Cup are live this week. Master League returns Nov 17.

No GO Battle Thursday Nov 12 — paused for Wild Area week. Next: Thu Nov 19 + Nov 26 (4× Stardust, up to 10 sets).

Why these picks: Rankings come from PvPoke — how each Pokémon does against the ones other players use most. The top picks win on four things: typing (what they beat), bulk (how long they survive), energy (how fast their fast move charges the big moves), and coverage (two charged moves so nothing walls them). Best team in each league is ranked #1 first — if you don’t have the top pick, take the next one down.

Upcoming

Coming up · Nov 14–30

White Kyurem is Sat Nov 14, Black Kyurem is Sun Nov 15 — both in 5-star raids at GO Wild Area.

  • To fuse: 1,000 Volt Fusion Energy (Black) or Blaze Fusion Energy (White) + 30 Kyurem Candy + 30 Zekrom Candy (Black) or Reshiram Candy (White).
  • Fused forms cannot be traded — so fuse the one you want to keep.
  • About 10 raids each.

Before you fuse — Glaciate: your Kyurem must know Glaciate BEFORE fusing (Elite Charged TM, or catch one that already knows it). No Glaciate = no Freeze Shock (Black) / Ice Burn (White), and those are gone for good — no TM adds them back, not even an Elite one. Fuse the high-IV Kyurem — the IVs and shiny come from Kyurem.

Duraludon makes its Gigantamax debut in 6-star Max Battles at GO Wild Area.

  • Worth remote passes — this is the big one of the weekend.
  • Each attempt costs 800 Max Particles, so stockpile now and don’t spend them on the small 1-star and 2-star Max Battles (Ralts and Machop).

A costumed Machamp is in 3-star raids all weekend — and a 3-star raid is soloable, so you can beat it on your own.

  • Costumed Pokémon can have a Special Background.

Dynamax Dialga is in Max Battles on Saturday at GO Wild Area. Catch it — you need Dialga for the Dynamax battles ahead.

Dynamax Palkia is in Max Battles on Sunday at GO Wild Area. Catch it — you need Palkia for the Dynamax battles ahead.

Minior, the Meteor Pokémon, falls from the sky in the evenings — look for shooting stars in the sky. A new core color makes its debut.

  • Best time: 5–9 PM each day, when Minior appears more often.
  • 1,000 Stardust for every Minior you catch.
  • You meet Minior in its Meteor Form in the wild — battle it and its shell breaks below half health to show its core.
  • Timed Research — finish and claim rewards by Thu Nov 19, 5 PM.

A week of Max Battles, Mon Nov 16, 10 AM – Mon Nov 23, 8 PM.

  • Every Dynamax Pokémon from before is back in Max Battles and wild spawns (no Legendaries or Mythicals).
  • More Power Spots are active than usual, and you get Max Particles from catches too.
  • Eternatus returns Sat Nov 21, 11 AM–2 PM — Eternamax Eternatus takes over Power Spots.
  • Early access: if you claimed the GO Pass: Into the Wild Tier 1 rewards, Dynamax Trails opens early Sat Nov 14, 10 AM. GO Pass rewards expire Wed Nov 25, 8 PM.

Thu Nov 19, 6–7 PM. The three Galar starters — Grookey, Scorbunny, and Sobble — appear more often.

  • Bonus: 2× Catch Candy. Feed them a Pinap berry to double it again.
  • A good hour to stock up on starter candy.

Sat Nov 21, 2–5 PM local. Pawniard appears everywhere, with more shiny chances and Special Backgrounds.

  • Bonuses: 2× Catch Candy, 2× chance of Candy XL (level 31+), 1/4 hatch distance, 3-hour Incense, 1-hour Lures.
  • Evolve Bisharp into Kingambit to get Kowtow Cleave — evolve during the event or up to 9 PM.
  • Kingambit shortcut: set Bisharp as your buddy, defeat 1 Dark- or Steel-type Raid Boss, then evolve (until 9 PM). After that the normal requirement comes back.
  • Trading until 9 PM: one extra Special Trade (2 total) and 50% less Stardust.
  • Optional $1.99 Special Research with Pawniard encounters, a Premium Battle Pass, and a Rare Candy XL.

Tue Nov 24, 10 AM – Mon Nov 30, 8 PM. The season closes out with costumed Pokémon and trade bonuses.

  • Sun Crown Pikachu and Moon Crown Pikachu in 1-star raids; Sun Scarf Espeon and Moon Scarf Umbreon in 3-star raids.
  • Wild: Staryu, Elgyem, Rockruff and more — with better shiny odds for Staryu and Elgyem.
  • Field Research: Applin and Maschiff (Nov 24–26), then Bramblin, costumed Drifblim, and costumed Gengar (Nov 26–30).
  • Mega raids: Beedrill, Houndoom, Sableye, and Manectric.
  • A GO Pass runs with Lucky trade and 2× Stardust bonuses.

Thu Nov 26, 6–7 PM. Noibat appears more often.

  • Bonus: 2× Catch Candy. Feed it a Pinap berry to double it again.
  • Noibat evolves into Noivern — a good one to have.

Sat Nov 28, 2–5 PM local. Mega Clefable makes its debut in Super Mega Raids — tougher than regular Mega Raids, so team up, and check the in-game map for Gyms hosting them.

  • Up to 6 free Raid Passes from spinning Gyms.
  • Mega Clefable can reach the new Super Max Mega Level, and gets Moonblast+ while Mega Evolved.
  • A good day to grab Mega Clefable energy and a strong Fairy attacker.

Poké Prep

Next 3 events

What to have ready for the next three events on the Upcoming list.

GO Wild Area: Global

Sat Nov 14 + Sun Nov 15 · 10 AM–6 PM local · Free (optional ticket $11.99)

  • Max Particles — bank a full 1,500 before the weekend. Each 5★/6★ Max Battle costs 800, only taken on a win.
  • Raid Passes — spin Gyms. Up to 3 free/day (6 with the ticket) — 6 free across the weekend, enough in person. Remote cap is unlimited Nov 14–15.
  • Kyurem fusion — 1,000 Fusion Energy + 30 Kyurem Candy + 30 Zekrom (Black) or Reshiram (White) Candy. About 6–12 wins per fusion. Kyurem MUST know Glaciate before fusing — it can’t be TM’d on after.
  • Gigantamax Duraludon — Fighting + Ground only, and a big lobby. Bring Gigantamax Machamp / Dynamax Excadrill. Needs 10–40 players — 3 alone can’t beat it.
  • Dynamax Dialga (Sat) / Palkia (Sun) — 5★ Max Battles, 800 MP per win. Dialga: Fighting/Ground. Palkia: Dragon/Fairy. Grab free GO Safari Balls from stops/gyms.

Pawniard Community Day

Sat Nov 21 · 2–5 PM local

  • Poké Balls + Pinap Berries — stocked up before 2 PM. A few hundred balls across the three of you. Pinap every Pawniard.
  • 150 Pawniard Candy per Kingambit. Pawniard → Bisharp 50, Bisharp → Kingambit 100 more. Evolve Bisharp 2–9 PM for Kowtow Cleave.
  • Set a Bisharp as Buddy first. On Nov 21, 2–9 PM, the 15-win requirement drops to 1 win.
  • Same morning: Eternamax Eternatus, 11 AM–2 PM. Can’t catch it, but each win gives ~100–140 Candy + 45–54 XL. Needs a big lobby.
  • Incense + Lures — one Incense each at 2 PM covers the whole event (3 hours).

Twilight Wishes

Tue Nov 24, 10 AM – Mon Nov 30, 8 PM local · Season finale

  • Save Lucky-trade candidates for this week. The free GO Pass gives increased Lucky chance (Rank 1) and 2× Stardust (Rank 10). Claim rewards by Wed Dec 2, 8 PM.
  • Star Pieces — save at least one per player for Nov 24–30. Stack with Rank 10 for the best Stardust of the month.
  • Mega Energy — don’t buy it, earn it from Mega Raids, Field Research, and the GO Pass.
  • Raid Passes — a few for the costumed 3★s (Espeon/Umbreon). One free daily pass covers one a day.
  • Same week: Mega Clefable Raid Day, Sat Nov 28, 2–5 PM. Same prep as any raid day.

All three are global/local-time and fully available in Rockledge — no travel. Duraludon + Eternatus need a big lobby.

How to get Max Particles: Power Spots are the purple glowing spots on the map — not the blue PokéStops. Tap to collect 100 per spot (120 the first time you visit a new one). Walk 2 km, then claim 300 more. Collect up to 800 a day and hold up to 1,500. Only lost on a Max Battle win.
